title: [ingest] Cooperative stop is enforced by the daemon inside next_action
summary: The heartbeat tick runs in-process so the PreToolUse stop hook cannot interrupt it. Instead every next_action first polls the loop’s stop signal (cancel on the loop’s claimed task or stop on its agent); if set it returns stop and clears loop.active, so the loop self-exits within one iteration. Pass session to loop_start to arm this.
